description: ES · Retail & E-Commerce · unisa.es Unisa Shoes is a Spanish footwear company founded in 1973 in Elche, Alicante, with 52 years of history across three generations of the Pérez Parres family. It designs and produces women's, men's and accessories collections sold in 70 plus countries through around 30 own stores, 150 plus Espacio Unisa points of sale and its e-commerce platform.
